name: Scarborough Summer Day Camp
description_short: A town-run day camp for Scarborough resident children entering grades K–6, held at Wentworth School. You sign up for the whole 7-week summer at once, and an optional Week 8 can be added. Campers do art, gym, themed programs and field trips.
refund_policy_summary: You enroll for all 7 weeks as one program. You can't drop single weeks; withdrawing means dropping all seven. The page doesn't say whether money is refunded.

warnings: Old season: the page shows only Summer 2026, which is over (today is 2026-10-13). Nothing has been posted for 2027 yet.
The 2026 dates were labeled 'tentative'. There was no camp on 7/3/2026, and Week 8 was 'not guaranteed'.
Only Scarborough residents can enroll ('any resident child').
The page doesn't sell single weeks; you must enroll for the full 7 weeks. So price_per_week is left blank. Price range: $1,650 to pay in full, $1,750 on the payment plan. Week 8 is an extra $275.
Conflicting payment info: one part of the page says 'No payment is required at the time of registration', but Week 8 is 'Paid in full at registration'.
Enrollment is capped by staffing levels; once full, families go on a waitlist.
